title: Flickr Publish Photo Views Leaderboard
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flickr:photo views=*
| stats sum(views) as total_value, avg(views) as avg_value by album_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks album name values by total and average views across Flickr publish photo events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `views` values for each Flickr publish photo event and review total and average views by album name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total views.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which album name shows the biggest views numbers in your Flickr publish photo data.
